hints.title: Core Idea
hints.text: Any pair of nodes in a connected tree can be xor-flipped together along their connecting path.

hints.title: Key Observation
hints.text: We can flip any even number of nodes. Calculate the net gain diff = (x ^ k) - x for each node.

hints.title: Algorithmic Steps
hints.text: Sort gains descending. Pair up positive gains. If an odd number of positive gains exists, compare leaving out the smallest positive gain vs flipping the greatest negative gain.

hints.title: Implementation

variables: n: number of nodes in tree
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Exponential search over tree edge selections is 2^E.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Realize that tree connectivity allows arbitrary pairs to flip simultaneously.
